verdict.rationale: Pulumi explicitly states it is 'an open source platform' and links to its public GitHub repository (pulumi/pulumi) with permissively-licensed IaC engine and SDKs, giving AI-native users source access to inspect and build from official docs. Missing for 10: explicit license name/text (e.g., Apache-2.0) in the evidence pack, and no independent corroboration that this openness extends beyond the core engine (Pulumi Cloud/Neo are proprietary services).
